necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) that are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring. To correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and determine the etiology of the collapse, a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended rhythm assessment. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the cause of the syncope and manage the atrial fibrillation, distinct from any bundled procedures.
